answer: A receipt holds, in this order: what you asked the agent, word for word; for a task, the checks Silo ran and their results; the files that changed, grouped, with what is only here; the commands that ran, with their exit codes; the hosts reached, how much was sent to each, and what was sent where Silo reads the traffic; the secrets used, by name; the model calls, with the spend, which models answered and the limits reached; the time, split between work and waiting; the asks raised and their answers; recordings of the screen, when an agent drove it; and what could not be attributed, and any gap. Each item shows whether it is a fact, a report or an opinion. An item Silo has no way to know for this work says so and stays empty.
